title: Division of the Kingdom
aliases: what happened in division of the kingdom
tell me about division of the kingdom
why is division of the kingdom important
summary: After Solomon's death, the united monarchy splits into the northern kingdom of Israel and the southern kingdom of Judah.
historical_context: The split follows political grievance, heavy labor, and fragile succession in the wake of Solomon's reign.
ancient_near_east_context: The event reflects a common ancient pattern of dynastic fracture, but Scripture interprets it as covenant consequence.
literary_context: 1 Kings 12 uses the division to explain why later history moves toward exile and prophetic critique.
covenantal_significance: The split shows the fragility of royal unity when covenant faithfulness is neglected.
interpretive_notes: The division is not merely a political breakup; it is a theological turning point.
The split shapes the rest of the Deuteronomistic history.
common_questions: What is the difference between Israel and Judah?
How does the division lead to exile?
